findings.evidence: Row sets version_status "published" and version "opt1-102", but SOURCE 1 and SOURCE 2 publish no release identifier for this board: the protocol page has no version field, metadata contains only total_tasks 102, and settings are Opt@1/Opt@10. Per c2, when the maintainer publishes no release identifier, version_status must be "snapshot" and version should be snapshot-<date>; "published" is unsupported and contradicts the source.
findings.repair: Change version_status to "snapshot" and version to "snapshot-2026-11-22" (the capture date) unless a maintainer-published release identifier can be established from source.

uncertainties: Owner-provided row and artifact SHA-256 hashes were accepted as binding; I could not independently recompute them.
The version_status finding rests on the absence of any release identifier in the supplied source excerpts rather than on an explicit statement from the maintainer.
